english.title: Fail to give an authorised officer of an enforcement authority facilities / assistance / information - Health Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable cause failed to give to **(..SPECIFY THE OFFICER..), an authorised officer of **(..SPECIFY THE ENFORCEMENT AUTHORITY..), acting in the exercise of

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

functions under or by virtue of Chapter 1 of the Health Act 2006, facilities, assistance or information, namely **(..SPECIFY..), which the officer reasonably required of you for the performance of those functions
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11(2) and (4) of the Health Act 2006.
